🚨 President Trump’s National Security Presidential Memorandum (NSPM) to Counter Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence Is Not Being Complied With By The IRS 🚨 

On September 25th, President Trump signed NSPM-7 “Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence” in the Oval Office, framing it as a bulwark against "organized political violence" from Antifa-inspired extremists and their enablers. 

Read here: https://t.co/6hjLovbAE8

In the memorandum, it says, “President Trump instructs the Secretary of the Treasury to identify and disrupt financial networks that fund domestic terrorism and political violence, and directs the IRS Commissioner to ensure tax-exempt entities do not directly or indirectly finance political violence or domestic terrorism, referring violators to the Department of Justice.”

The IRS website clearly states that nonprofit organizations cannot engage in political activity: “Under the Internal Revenue Code, all section 501(c)(3) organizations are absolutely prohibited from directly or indirectly participating in, or intervening in, any political campaign on behalf of (or in opposition to) any candidate for elective public office.” 

Last night, outside of the White House, the Palestinian Youth Movement
member was attacking President Trump at the protest they organized. In addition to attacking President Trump, the group also called to “globalize the intifada”, a direct call for political violence. 2 weeks ago, in Detroit, Michigan, PYM members were caught on video calling for political violence and the sabotage of America’s F-35 supply chain. This is a felony, yet the IRS under @SecScottBessent won’t revoke their 501c3 status. 

That’s a violation of the PYM’s nonprofit status. It should be revoked. But they haven’t had their 501c3 status revoked yet despite pressure from sitting US Senators like @SenTomCotton. 

Scott Bessent, who has a decades-long professional relationship with billionaire financier George Soros, has not revoked the 501c3 status of radical left groups. Given his Knowledge of the Soros network, Bessent of all people should know first hand how dangerous these radical left groups are. Bessent has the authority to make America Safe Again by cracking down on these radical left 501c3s, and President Trump has specifically called for a review of all 501c3s funded by Soros. 

This is not personal. This is about complying with President Trump’s executive memorandum for the sake of combatting domestic terrorism and political violence. 

There are thousands of leftist groups in the US just like PYM that are engaged in partisan political activity and incitement of political violence who haven’t had their 501c3 statuses revoked.

We have an acting IRS Director @SecScottBessent who has the authority to revoke these statuses, and who has been ordered to do so by President Trump, but he hasn’t despite these violations being brought to his attention. 

I’d like to know why the IRS is protecting the radical left and is not complying with President Trump’s most recent memorandum Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence.

Read memo here: https://t.co/6hjLovbAE8

This is a direct violation of the law and it should concern everyone that the acting IRS Director is not taking action. 

Every single GOP Rep should contact @SecScottBessent and ask him why he hasn’t revoked the 501c3 status of these radical leftist groups that incite violence and why he is not in compliant with President Trump’s most recent memorandum. 

Receipts 👇🏻@realDonaldTrump @StephenM @JDVance
